summary: Climb Bio, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $100 million of its common stock through Jefferies as sales agent. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under an existing registration statement, not a special situation. Sales will occur at market prices via ordinary brokers' transactions, with Jefferies receiving up to 3.0% commission. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. There are no transformative corporate events, board recommendations, or deal terms beyond the at-the-market mechanics. This is a standard capital-raising activity, not a merger, acquisition, or restructuring.
